pages.description: Miramichi Treehouse & Camping Adventures is the place to stay when exploring the Miramichi! Chose from 12 tree houses, 6 Cottages, RV and tent sites. Relax around the pool, walk our nature trails, Enjoy the magic that is all around!

What People are Saying!
Summer fun. .
It was a wonderful place to stay. The Miramichi is such a beautiful place and this just adds to it. Friendly owner and beautiful property. Very clean treehouse and clean washrooms. Takes you back to your childhood. You are sleeping in a REAL TREEHOUSE! Can't wait to go back next summer!
~Susie
Fun in the Sun ...
This is our third year of making memories with our grandchildren. We love the treehouses and the owners are so nice always got a smile. Treehouses are clean and lots are well kept! The fairies keep the kids searching . Thank you and we will be back!
~Melissa
Striper Fishing..
Awesome location for access to great rivers. Close to shopping and very quiet. Extended our stay by 3 more nights...so clean and well organized. Our dog loved the trails for walking. Stayed May 22-29 2019.
~Hussey Family

book Now
A few things you need to know about a stay in the Treehouse: Please Read before making a reservation!
There are no Pets allowed in the tree houses
Prices below are (week day/weekend)
Check-in is between 3 - 9pm and check-out is 11am
There is a 2 night minimum on the weekends - if you book a Friday you must book a Saturday and vice versa. And a 3 night minimum on most holiday weekends. There is no minimum during the week.
You will need to bring everything that you would for camping except your tent! We do rent BBQs and bedding if needed!
There is no outside firewood allowed in the campground. You can purchase a bundle for $8.00 or buy 4 and get the 5th one free.
The second half of your payment will automatically come out 30 days before you arrive.
The number of people staying in a treehouse is not to exceed the guidelines below. Doing so may result in your reservation being cancelled without a refund
